name: Read My Chaos
description: The flagship intake crew: turns an operator's OWN inbox and chat exports (Gmail, Viber, LINE) into structured ledgers — orders, payments, claims, follow-ups — plus a short operator brief of what needs action today.

policy.notes: Legal bright line (SUPERMEGA-MASTER-STRATEGY): only accounts the tenant owns and exports themselves — never third-party groups, never scraped chats. Personal and non-business threads are skipped, never stored. The crew reads and structures; it never sends, replies, or mutates the source account.

intake.description: Chat/inbox exports the tenant made from their OWN accounts. Injection frames are stripped at the gateway (stripInjectionFrames) before any content reaches a model.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Split raw exports into per-thread units, drop personal/non-business threads entirely (skip_personal — do not extract, do not store), and tag each remaining unit with source, counterparty, and date range.

roles.title: Ledger Extractor
roles.goal: Pull structured rows out of each unit: orders (item, qty, amount_mmk), payments (method, amount_mmk, reference), claims/complaints, and promised follow-ups — with the source quote attached to every row so nothing is unverifiable.

roles.title: Brief Writer
roles.goal: Cross-check the extracted ledgers, merge duplicates across channels (the same order confirmed in Viber and Gmail is ONE order), and write the operator brief: what changed, what is owed, what needs a reply today. Cite ledger rows; never invent.

output_contract.description: Structured ledgers (same shape the Gmail extractor emits, so they merge into one dataset) plus operator_brief markdown. skipped_personal_count is reported so the tenant can see the skip_personal policy actually working.
